sections.description: A two-panel HTML generator for WordPress. Compose visually in TinyMCE on the left and watch the formatted HTML appear in real time on the right. Available as a Tools page in the admin and as a [mbr_html_generator] shortcode on the frontend. TinyMCE is bundled locally (GPL community edition) — no external CDN, no API keys, no telemetry, no premium tier.
sections.changelog:
1.8.1

  • Security: Updated the bundled TinyMCE from 8.5.0 to 8.6.0. TinyMCE 8.5.1 addressed several stored cross-site scripting (XSS) issues, including one in the media plugin (which this plugin loads) affecting crafted data-mce-object / data-mce-p- attributes, plus issues involving unsanitised data-mce-href, data-mce-src, and data-mce-style attributes. 8.6.0 is the current stable release and includes those fixes. Drop-in dependency update — no configuration or markup changes required.

1.8.0

  • New: Self-hosted update checking via Plugin Update Checker 5.7, with the manifest served from the public HarbourBob/mbr-updates GitHub repo. Updates surface on the standard WordPress Plugins/Updates screens.
  • Changed: Footer credit link now points to https://madebyrobert.co.uk.

1.7.2

  • New: Inline colour swatches in the output panel for hex, rgb(), rgba(), hsl(), and hsla() values. Display-only — copied/downloaded output is untouched.
